<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd
import os

# Read the input matrix from T11
input_path = 'outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(input_path)

# Identify indicator columns (all columns except city_id, city_name, year)
id_columns = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']
indicator_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in id_columns]

# Compute missingness per indicator
missing_counts = {}
missing_rates = {}

for col in indicator_cols:
    total = len(df)
    missing = df[col].isna().sum()
    rate = missing / total if total > 0 else 0.0
    missing_counts[col] = missing
    missing_rates[col] = rate

# Create missingness report
report_data = []
for col in indicator_cols:
    kept = 'true' if missing_rates[col] <= 0.30 else 'false'
    report_data.append({
        'indicator': col,
        'missing_count': missing_counts[col],
        'missing_rate': missing_rates[col],
        'kept': kept
    })

report_df = pd.DataFrame(report_data)
report_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv', index=False)

# Select indicators with missing_rate <= 0.30
selected_indicators = [col for col in indicator_cols if missing_rates[col] <= 0.30]

# Create selected matrix
selected_columns = id_columns + selected_indicators
selected_df = df[selected_columns]
selected_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv', index=False)

print(f"Missingness report written with {len(report_df)} indicators.")
print(f"Selected matrix written with {len(selected_indicators)} indicators (missing_rate <= 0.30).")
</solution_file>
